source: class StringMaps { public List<Dictionary<string, string>> Values = []; }
class CoinMaps { public List<Dictionary<string, Coin>> Values = []; }
public static int AddScalarId() { StringMaps h = new(); Coin c = new(); h.Values.Add({}); h.Values[0].Add("k", c.Id); Coins other = new(); other.Values.Add(c); return other.Values[0].Value; }

public static int AssignScalarId() { StringMaps h = new(); Coin c = new(); h.Values.Add({"k": "before"}); h.Values[0]["k"] = c.Id; Coins other = new(); other.Values.Add(c); return other.Values[0].Value; }
public static int RefuseOwned() { CoinMaps h = new(); Coin c = new(); h.Values.Add({}); h.Values[0].Add("k", c); Coins other = new(); other.Values.Add(c); return 1; }

public static int RemoveThenTransfer() { CoinMaps h = new(); Coin c = new(); h.Values.Add({}); h.Values[0].Add("k", c); h.Values[0].Remove("k"); Coins other = new(); other.Values.Add(c); return other.Values[0].Value; }
